description: Returns an integration strategy and step-by-step plan for Hyperhuman workouts or programs: embed (iframe), stream videos (VOD export), or custom player (API + playlist). Use when the user asks how to integrate Hyperhuman or what integration options exist. Pass platform (web/mobile/hardware/cms) and use_case (mvp, programs, ai_generated, vod, corporate_wellness and more). Not for copy-paste embed HTML snippets (use get_embed_code_samples for those).

platform.description: Where the workouts will run: "web" (site or web app), "mobile" (native app), "hardware" (gym screen or device), "cms" (website builder). Defaults to "web".

use_case.description: What to build. "mvp" = browse and play workouts (embed on web/cms, custom player elsewhere); "programs" or "plans" = multi-week program pages; "ai_generated" = AI workouts made on the fly; "vod" or "stream" = full-length videos for a VOD player or CMS; "premium_coaching", "corporate_wellness" or "native" = your own player via the API. Defaults to "mvp".

name: get_integration_plan
title: Get integration plan
